author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball Super's Goku Black and Future Trunks arc has been often referred to as inconic and DEEPLY flawed. Broken internal logic, timelines that make no sense and official explanations that demonstrate even the studio's behind the story didn't know what was going on, since it's debut the Goku Black arc has gone down as one of the most fun and confusing stories to come out of the Dragon Ball pipeline. 

However, with The Dragon Ball Super remaster right around the corner, I started to wonder... What if all this time, the only thing holding back the Future Trunks arc of Super, were the minds behind the story that didn't understand it. What if I could solve the Goku Black arc's biggest issue... it's timelines. 

Special thanks to PlagueofGripes for inspiring this video and another MASSIVE thanks to our writer Von for doing the research and helping with this script! Couldn't have done it without you!

Goku Black Theme (Friedrich Habe
title: The Goku Black Plot Hole Isn't Real
